purpose: Determine whether a native macOS Synology Chat client can communicate directly with the server while retaining the existing dark visual design.
status: Historical initial investigation snapshot. Current native implementation and release status are maintained in the roadmap and release audit; the initial read-only/unfinished statements below are historical.

tool.name: REA
tool.installation: Project-local ignored cache; npm dependencies installed with lifecycle scripts disabled; no global MCP configuration modified.

findings.claim: Both desktop versions embed the server-delivered Chat web application in an Electron webview.
findings.basis: Recovered webpack source maps contain src/App.vue with a webview; source SHA256 is identical across both releases: cf21680191ef1b380e8800f7214b4f13c450d839ec5268dddfb12c32619a09da. The session module builds ?launchApp=SYNO.SDS.Chat.Application.

findings.claim: The desktop bundle provides discovery, authentication, session validation and native integration code, but this does not recover the full messaging protocol.
findings.basis: background.js API calls and preload.js bridge to SYNO.SDS.Chat.Application; message UI is loaded from the server.

observed_api_contracts.purpose: Discover API endpoint paths and supported versions.
Obtain parameters for the sendEnc authentication envelope; exact cryptographic implementation still needs documenting.
Desktop session validation before loading the web application. Does not establish the live-message transport.

request_routing.encoding: Form POST; individual values JSON encoded when the API metadata requests JSON.
request_routing.verification: Statically observed; not tested against the user server.

remaining_unknowns: Standalone login/OTP and secure credential lifecycle
Replies, reactions, editing, deletions and unread-state behavior
Native UI refinement and broader compatibility tests
next_vertical_slice: Inspect server-delivered JavaScript and observe authorised network traffic
Prove list conversations, load history, send and receive
Implement native AppKit or SwiftUI views using the existing dark theme as the visual reference
preserved: Pre-existing changes to ChatWindowController.swift and WebNotificationBridge.swift

validated_read_only_calls.result: 22 users; bot records can omit username
15 joined channels, zero encrypted channels at observation time
Membership resolved without calling enter or marking messages read
History decoded by native Swift client; first probe read 9 posts

wire_contract.body: Form encoding with JSON-encoded typed parameters for requestFormat=JSON; api, method and version remain plain fields

preview.framework: SwiftUI with AppKit window; no WKWebView
preview.launch: scripts/package-native-preview.sh then open build/Synology Chat API Preview.app
preview.scope: List conversations, resolve member names, read recent history, request earlier history and refresh manually
preview.session: Explicit button imports the user-established official desktop session into memory. Temporary development bridge; production sign-in still required.
preview.storage: Ephemeral URLSession, no API response disk cache, no token logging; default HTTPS validation retained; all redirects refused.

live_transport_static.limits: Connection, handshake, session connection ID, reconnection, replay and event processing not yet runtime validated.

remaining: Standalone login/OTP and secure credential lifecycle
Replies, reactions, editing, deletions and unread-state behavior
Native UI refinement and broader compatibility tests

validation.swift_test: 15 tests passed, including URL encoding, session-error responses, unsupported versions, bot records, built-in names and millisecond timestamps
validation.live_swift_probe: Passed discovery, user decoding, channel decoding, post history and member lookup; 15 channels, 22 users, 9 posts in initial unencrypted-channel probe
validation.native_UI: Observed actual server data in the separate dark SwiftUI window; verified conversation selection, corrected timestamps, latest-message scroll and loading earlier history
validation.mutations: No messages sent, channels entered, or read-state mutations issued.
validation.scope: Local development build; no release or feature-parity claim.

initial_static_limitations: Static analysis only; no target app code executed.
REA graph coverage is partial and static references do not establish runtime behavior.
The update REA run deliberately selected three source files; additional bundle comparison used direct inert source inspection.
Downloaded proprietary reference files remain in the ignored cache and should not be redistributed.
limitations: The native preview is read-only and uses a temporary official-session import bridge.
Live Socket.IO behavior, writes, attachment rendering and encrypted conversations are not implemented or validated.
The operation index is static evidence; only the named read-only calls have been exercised.
Vendor code and raw REA evidence are kept in the ignored reference cache, not redistributed in the app.

compatibility_incident_2026_10_16.impact: Backend accepted text but created malformed system records; official web client failed while reading them.
compatibility_incident_2026_10_16.resolution: Four malformed own synthetic roots soft-deleted; web UI reload verified. Prior send/action claims require revalidation with official client.

latest_native_validation.message_type: normal is the only supported text-create kind; malformed success responses rejected; corrected live text interoperability remains unverified.
latest_native_validation.socket_recovery: A stream wrapper finishes immediately on local cancel; forced transport loss and automatic reconnect passed against the server.
latest_native_validation.notification_preferences: SYNO.Chat.User.Preference/get/v4 -> data.preferences; notification_showmessage, notification_browser_active, notification_mute are Boolean.
latest_native_validation.notification_events: Only normalized client.notification.create payload.post is eligible. Native UI reads fresh privacy preferences and requires explicit OS opt-in.
latest_native_validation.message_context: SYNO.Chat.Post/list/v5 with post_id, prev_count15,next_count15 opened an existing search hit in the native timeline.
latest_native_validation.ui_download: NSSavePanel followed by native download produced exact synthetic attachment bytes.
